lines: Tattha dunnikkhittaṃ mālanti cetiye pūjākaraṇaṭṭhāne nirantaraṭṭhapanādinā racanāvisesena aṭṭhapetvā yathānikkhittatāya na suṭṭhu nikkhittaṃ, vātena vā paharitvā dunnikkhittaṃ pupphaṃ.
Sunikkhipitvāti suṭṭhu nikkhipitvā racanāvisesena dassanīyaṃ pāsādikaṃ katvā nikkhipiya.
Taṃ vā pupphaṃ nikkhipanto satthu cetiyaṃ uddissa mama santāne kusaladhammaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvāti evaṃ ettha attho daṭṭhabbo.

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Tena samayena āyasmā mahāmoggallāno heṭṭhā vuttanayeneva devacārikaṃ caranto tāvatiṃsabhavanaṃ upagato.
Tasmiñca khaṇe aññataro devaputto attano vimānadvāre ṭhito āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ disvā sañjātagāravabahumāno upasaṅkamitvā pañcapatiṭṭhitena vanditvā añjaliṃ paggayha aṭṭhāsi.

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: So kira atīte kassapasammāsambuddhe parinibbute tassa sarīradhātuyo pakkhipitvā yojanike kanakathūpe ca kate catasso parisā kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamitvā gandhapupphadhūpādīhi cetiye pūjaṃ karonti, tattha aññataro upāsako aññesu pupphapūjaṃ katvā gatesu tehi pūjitaṭṭhāne dunnikkhittāni pupphāni disvā tattheva tāni sammadeva ṭhapento sannivesavasena dassanīyaṃ pāsādikaṃ vibhattivisesayuttaṃ pupphapūjaṃ akāsi.
Katvā ca pana etaṃ ārammaṇaṃ gaṇhanto satthu guṇe anussaritvā pasannacitto taṃ puññaṃ hadaye ṭhapesi.

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: So aparabhāge kālaṃ katvā tasseva kammassa ānubhāvena tāvatiṃsabhavane dvādasayojanike kanakavimāne nibbatti, mahānubhāvo mahā cassa parivāro ahosi.
Taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ “tasmiñca khaṇe aññataro devaputto … pe … aṭṭhāsī”ti.
Atha naṃ āyasmā mahāmoggallāno yathāladdhasampattikittanamukhena katasucaritakammaṃ imāhi gāthāhi pucchi –

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Kūṭāgārā sattasatā uḷārā, veḷuriyathambhā rucakatthatā subhā.

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Tatthacchasi pivasi khādasi ca, dibbā ca vīṇā pavadanti vagguṃ;

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Dibbā rasā kāmaguṇettha pañca, nāriyo ca naccanti suvaṇṇachannā.

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Kena tetādiso vaṇṇo, kena te idha mijjhati;

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Uppajjanti ca te bhogā, ye keci manaso piyā.

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Pucchāmi taṃ deva mahānubhāva, manussabhūto kimakāsi puññaṃ;

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Sopi tassa attano katakammaṃ imāhi gāthāhi kathesi.

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi, yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ”.

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Mahiddhiko camhi mahānubhāvo, dibbehi kāmehi samaṅgibhūto.

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo, tena me idha mijjhati;

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Uppajjanti ca me bhogā, ye keci manaso piyā.

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: “Akkhāmi te bhikkhu mahānubhāva, manussabhūto yamahaṃ akāsiṃ;

before.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Tenamhi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.

after.title: Sunikkhittavimānavaṇṇanā
lines: Evaṃ devaputtena attano sucaritakamme pakāsite thero tassa dhammaṃ desetvā āgantvā bhagavato tamatthaṃ nivedesi.
Bhagavā taṃ aṭṭhuppattiṃ katvā sampattamahājanassa dhammaṃ desesi.

after.title: Nigamanakathā
lines: Yā tattha paramatthānaṃ, tattha tattha yathārahaṃ;

after.title: Nigamanakathā
lines: Iti taṃ saṅkharontena, yaṃ taṃ adhigataṃ mayā;

after.title: Nigamanakathā
lines: Tasmiṃ sagāravā niccaṃ, hontu sabbepi pāṇino.
